passwordFixtureNote: The password fixture now reuses a locally cached terminal-smoke-password-sshd image instead of forcing a docker build, so password acceptance stays runnable while the Docker daemon cannot reach the registry.
limitations: This is the dedicated real-SSH smoke workflow, not a stopwatch measurement of a normal user cold launch with an existing SQLite workspace.
Windows, Pageant, serial hardware, and human physical keyboard/IME acceptance remain unverified.
Real lid-close sleep/wake, VPN handover, and cellular network switching remain unobserved on macOS hardware; the host-wake case synthesizes the retryable wake checkpoint.

source.note: Debug evidence cannot be validated against the artifact on disk, because pnpm verify relinks target/debug/terminal as a bare cargo build. This content fingerprint of the sources these scenarios exercise is what makes a stale measurement detectable.
